purpose: Canonical source and activation-status registry for G8 central-bank pricing. ACTIVE means the production OIS runtime has validated source, as-of, meeting path and 1D/1W change fields. WITHHELD means the production runtime must remain null until the stated blocker is resolved. Proxy substitution is prohibited unless explicitly reclassified by methodology review.

AUD.method: Direct official futures buckets, 100 minus rate, no interpolation

CAD.method: Direct official quarterly settlement buckets, 100 minus compounded CORRA, no interpolation

GBP.instrument: Estimated sterling instantaneous OIS forward curve based on SONIA
GBP.method: Exact 3M/6M/12M official BoE short-end OIS forward-curve columns; no interpolation; not futures settlements

JPY.method: Direct official quarterly futures buckets, 100 minus compounded TONA, no interpolation

validated_so_far: T-1 official reconstruction from CME settlement and point-change fields
USD.activation_blocker: Homogeneous official T-5 snapshot still unavailable in the current automated environment. CME archive file IR.20261002.csv exists but returns HTTP 403 to the GitHub runner; historical Daily Bulletin access routes to CME DataMine.
USD.activation_condition: Obtain an official CME T-5 snapshot for the required ZQ contracts on the same basis as current/T-1, then compute and validate 1W changes. Do not use secondary settlement sources or inferred T-5 values.

EUR.activation_blocker: The free official Eurex daily-statistics files contain traded contracts, averages, P/C ratio, open interest and EUR volumes, but no contract settlement prices. Common historical date parameters on the public order-book endpoint return current/delayed data rather than target-date history.
EUR.activation_condition: Obtain homogeneous official Eurex settlement prices for the required FST3 contracts for current, T-1 and approximately T-5 business days. Do not infer from volume statistics or realized compounded Euro STR.

validated_so_far: public ICE product metadata and marketId
CHF.activation_blocker: The public ICE product page exposes contract metadata and contract final-settlement dates, not reproducible daily historical settlement prices. Historical end-of-day listed-market data is distributed through ICE data/report services rather than a free public series suitable for the required 22/28/29 September history.
CHF.activation_condition: Obtain official ICE daily settlements for the required SA3 contracts for current, T-1 and approximately T-5 business days. Do not use secondary prices or the existing stale proxy fields.

NZD.official_source: Reserve Bank of New Zealand / NZD OIS market
NZD.instrument: NZD OIS linked to OCR expectations
validated_so_far: RBNZ uses OIS to interpret OCR expectations
public RBNZ B2 provides OCR, bank bills and standard swaps
NZD.activation_blocker: The public RBNZ B2 history does not publish the required OIS curve. Public standard NZD swap series reference the 90-day bank bill floating leg and are not a clean OCR/OIS substitute; RBNZ policy publications source OIS market pricing externally rather than as a public RBNZ daily series.
NZD.activation_condition: Obtain a reproducible official or directly licensed NZD OIS series with homogeneous current, T-1 and approximately T-5 observations for 3M/6M/12M. Do not silently substitute bank-bill futures or standard bank-bill swaps.

governance.rule: Better WITHHELD than a weak proxy. A currency can move to ACTIVE only after source, as-of, meeting path and 1D/1W change fields are validated on homogeneous data.
